title: What is your preferred way to create gameplay trailers with AI?
author: CapitanUncino19
selftext:
I have tried recording gameplay myself and having AI edit it and also having AI record the gameplay and edit it all on its own.

Both lead to okayish results, but with both approaches I need many iterations to get something halfway decent. What are your experiences?

comments.author: West_Satisfaction299
comments.body: Well I have a much simpler game. I prefer to let AI do the short form videos. It build its own engine to do that and now one shots these videos 90% of the time. But go back a few months, we'd have to go through 2 to 3 iterations to get it done.

replies.author: West_Satisfaction299
replies.body: So it (Claude) does all the videos via HTML5. That's as much as I understand. The only thing I do research on is trending formats.

replies.author: CapitanUncino19
replies.body: Where do you post the videos?

replies.author: West_Satisfaction299
replies.body: The usual places, Instagram, YouTube and TikTok though TikTok has been the most succesful though with the wrong audience. Trying to get cozy gamers but getting almost all other devs.

comments.author: Soul_Mate_4ever
comments.body: I asked my Claude to make a trailer for the game and it made a really good one. It even made background music and all that. Just do that.

replies.author: CapitanUncino19
replies.body: Do you mind sharing it? I feel the results are always mid and need a lot of iteration to reach good.

comments.author: dagerika
comments.body: the simulation is smooth but what is this game about?

replies.author: CapitanUncino19
replies.body: You are a god of a remote island. You help your followers build up their village and defend it against threats.
